KNLS New Life Station FAQ

What frequency is KNLS New Life Station on?
In the A-26 season KNLS New Life Station is scheduled on 13 shortwave frequencies, including 7355, 9465, 9545, 9580, 9615, 9685 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9695 kHz (4 am – 5 am Eastern). For Europe: 9695 kHz (9 am – 10 am UTC+1).

Can I hear KNLS New Life Station in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9695 kHz (4 am – 5 am Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does KNLS New Life Station broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 7355 kHz at 12:00–13:00 UTC to Far East; 9580 kHz at 10:00–11:00 UTC to Far East; 9580 kHz at 14:00–15:00 UTC to Far East; 9695 kHz at 08:00–09:00 UTC to Far East; 9795 kHz at 12:00–13:00 UTC to Far East.

Is KNLS New Life Station on the air right now?
As of Wednesday, September 23, 2026, 09:58 UTC, KNLS New Life Station is scheduled to be broadcasting on 9545 kHz to Far East. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
